assessments.title: Configure an AI Agent for Customer Support
assessments.scenario: You are tasked with setting up an AI agent for a retail company to handle customer inquiries about order status, returns, and product information.
assessments.instructions:
1. Access the AI platform and create a new agent.
2. Configure the agent settings to include generative AI orchestration.
3. Define skills for handling order status, returns, and product information inquiries.
4. Set up triggers for common customer queries.
5. Test the agent to ensure it responds accurately to sample inquiries.
expected_outputs: A configured AI agent with defined skills for customer support
Triggers set up for common customer queries
Successful test results showing accurate responses

assessments.title: Design a Conversational Flow for a Banking Chatbot
assessments.scenario: A bank wants to implement a chatbot to assist customers with account balance inquiries, transaction history, and branch locations.
assessments.instructions:
1. Use the Topics tab to define intents for account balance inquiries, transaction history, and branch locations.
2. Create conversation flows for each intent, ensuring smooth transitions and accurate responses.
3. Use the Evaluation tab to set up test cases for each conversation flow.
4. Analyze user engagement using the Activity tab to identify areas for improvement.
expected_outputs: Defined intents and conversation flows for each banking service
Test cases set up in the Evaluation tab
User engagement analysis report with improvement suggestions

assessments.title: Integrate an AI Agent with a CRM System
assessments.scenario: A company wants to integrate their AI agent with a CRM system to automate customer data retrieval and update processes.
assessments.instructions:
1. Access the AI platform and navigate to the Connectors/Integrations section.
2. Set up a system integration with the company's CRM system.
3. Define actions for retrieving and updating customer data via API calls.
4. Deploy the agent to a web chat channel using the Channels tab.
5. Test the integration to ensure data is accurately retrieved and updated.
expected_outputs: Successful integration with the CRM system
Defined actions for data retrieval and updates
Agent deployed to a web chat channel
Test results showing accurate data handling

assessments.title: Implement Security and Governance for an AI Agent
assessments.scenario: A healthcare provider needs to ensure their AI agent complies with security protocols and governance standards for handling patient data.
assessments.instructions:
1. Access the AI platform and navigate to the Settings button.
2. Configure agent authentication and security settings to comply with healthcare standards.
3. Ensure the agent adheres to governance and responsible AI principles.
4. Use the Analytics tab to monitor agent performance and compliance.
expected_outputs: Configured security settings for agent authentication
Governance and responsible AI principles implemented
Analytics report showing compliance and performance metrics

assessments.title: Develop a Responsible AI Governance Framework
assessments.scenario: A tech company wants to establish a responsible AI governance framework for their AI agents to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability.
assessments.instructions:
1. Review Microsoft's Responsible AI principles and FAQs.
2. Design a content safety policy for AI agents using the Content Safety Configuration skill.
3. Develop a framework for AI ethics and compliance, integrating fairness checks and documenting AI decision-making processes.
4. Conduct an impact assessment to evaluate the framework's effectiveness.

rubrics.assessment_ref: Configure an AI Agent for Customer Support

criteria.novice: Agent is created but lacks proper configuration; skills are not clearly defined.
criteria.competent: Agent is created with basic configuration; skills for handling inquiries are defined but may lack depth.
criteria.expert: Agent is fully configured with advanced settings; skills are comprehensively defined and optimized for customer support.

criteria.novice: Triggers for common queries are missing or incorrectly set up.
criteria.competent: Triggers are set up for common queries but may not cover all scenarios.
criteria.expert: Triggers are comprehensively set up, covering a wide range of common customer queries.

criteria.novice: Agent testing is incomplete or shows inaccurate responses to inquiries.
criteria.competent: Agent testing is complete with mostly accurate responses; minor inaccuracies may exist.
criteria.expert: Agent testing is thorough with consistently accurate responses to all sample inquiries.

rubrics.assessment_ref: Design a Conversational Flow for a Banking Chatbot

criteria.novice: Intents and conversation flows are poorly defined or incomplete.
criteria.competent: Intents and conversation flows are defined with some smooth transitions; minor gaps may exist.
criteria.expert: Intents and conversation flows are expertly defined with seamless transitions and accurate responses.

criteria.novice: Test cases are missing or inadequately set up in the Evaluation tab.
criteria.competent: Test cases are set up for each conversation flow but may lack thoroughness.
criteria.expert: Test cases are comprehensively set up, covering all conversation flows with detailed scenarios.

criteria.novice: User engagement analysis is incomplete or lacks actionable insights.
criteria.competent: User engagement analysis is conducted with some improvement suggestions.
criteria.expert: User engagement analysis is thorough, providing detailed insights and actionable improvement suggestions.

rubrics.assessment_ref: Integrate an AI Agent with a CRM System

criteria.novice: Integration with the CRM system is incomplete or incorrectly configured.
criteria.competent: Integration is set up with basic functionality; some issues may persist.
criteria.expert: Integration is expertly set up, ensuring seamless data retrieval and updates.

criteria.novice: Actions for data retrieval and updates are poorly defined or missing.
criteria.competent: Actions are defined but may lack efficiency or completeness.
criteria.expert: Actions are comprehensively defined, ensuring efficient and accurate data handling.

criteria.novice: Agent deployment is incomplete or testing shows significant issues.
criteria.competent: Agent is deployed with minor issues in testing; most data handling is accurate.
criteria.expert: Agent is successfully deployed with thorough testing showing accurate data handling.

rubrics.assessment_ref: Implement Security and Governance for an AI Agent

criteria.novice: Security settings are poorly configured or non-compliant with standards.

item_bank.stem: Design a conversation flow for an AI agent that handles customer inquiries about product returns. Include intents, triggers, and responses.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should include a detailed conversation flow with defined intents such as 'Product Return Inquiry', triggers like 'User mentions return', and responses that guide the user through the return process.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the clarity and completeness of the conversation flow, ensuring it covers all necessary steps for handling product return inquiries.

item_bank.stem: Analyze the user engagement data from the Analytics tab to identify areas where the AI agent's conversation design can be improved.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The analysis should identify patterns in user interactions, such as frequent drop-off points or misunderstood intents, and suggest improvements to the conversation design.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Look for a thorough analysis that uses data to support conclusions and provides actionable recommendations for improving user engagement.

item_bank.stem: Configure an AI agent to authenticate users before providing access to sensitive information. Describe the steps and settings involved.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should detail the configuration process, including setting up authentication protocols and managing security settings to ensure only authorized users can access sensitive information.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Check for a comprehensive explanation of the authentication setup, including any security protocols used and how they protect sensitive data.

item_bank.stem: You are tasked with integrating an AI agent with an external CRM system to update customer records. Outline the steps you would take to achieve this integration.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should include steps such as identifying the CRM API endpoints, configuring the agent to make API calls, and testing the integration to ensure customer records are updated correctly.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the completeness and accuracy of the integration steps, including any testing procedures to verify successful updates.

item_bank.stem: Evaluate the effectiveness of a newly deployed AI agent by managing test cases in the Evaluation tab. What metrics would you use to measure accuracy and quality?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The evaluation should include metrics such as response accuracy, relevancy, user satisfaction scores, and error rates to assess the agent's performance.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Look for a detailed explanation of each metric and how it contributes to evaluating the agent's effectiveness.

item_bank.stem: Describe how you would configure content safety settings for an AI agent to ensure it adheres to organizational safety policies.
item_bank.competency_ref: Responsible AI Governance: Content Safety Configuration
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should include steps for setting up content moderation filters, defining safety guardrails, and testing the agent's behavior against organizational policies.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Check for a thorough configuration process that aligns with organizational safety standards and includes testing for compliance.

item_bank.stem: Develop a governance framework for ensuring AI agents comply with responsible AI principles. What key elements would you include?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The framework should include elements such as fairness checks, transparency in decision-making, accountability measures, and regular compliance audits.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the comprehensiveness of the framework and its alignment with responsible AI principles.

item_bank.stem: You need to deploy an AI agent across multiple communication channels. Explain the process using the Channels tab and any challenges you might face.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The response should detail the steps for deploying the agent using the Channels tab, including selecting channels, configuring settings, and addressing potential challenges like channel-specific limitations.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Assess the clarity and completeness of the deployment process, including how challenges are identified and mitigated.

item_bank.stem: Analyze the performance analytics of an AI agent to ensure it complies with governance standards. What indicators would you look for?
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The analysis should focus on indicators such as compliance with response time standards, user satisfaction metrics, and adherence to security protocols.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Look for a detailed analysis that uses specific indicators to assess compliance with governance standards.

item_bank.stem: Design a set of actions for an AI agent that can automate the process of scheduling meetings, including API calls and email notifications.
item_bank.expected_response_summary: The design should include actions such as calling a calendar API to check availability, sending email notifications for meeting confirmations, and updating the calendar with scheduled meetings.
item_bank.scoring_notes: Evaluate the completeness and functionality of the action set, ensuring it covers all necessary steps for automating meeting scheduling.

blueprint.target_audience: AI developers, system integrators, and IT professionals working in enterprise environments who are responsible for creating, managing, and deploying AI agents.
blueprint.prerequisites: Candidates should have a foundational understanding of AI concepts, basic programming skills, and familiarity with enterprise IT environments.
blueprint.program_overview:
The AI Champion Certification is designed to validate the expertise of professionals in the creation, configuration, and management of AI agents within enterprise settings. This certification ensures that candidates possess the necessary skills to design conversational interfaces, integrate AI systems with external platforms, and adhere to stringent security and governance standards. The program covers a comprehensive range of topics, including agent creation, conversational design, system integration, and responsible AI governance, equipping candidates with the knowledge to implement AI solutions that are both effective and compliant.

Candidates will gain proficiency in configuring AI agents, defining actions and triggers, and managing conversation flows to ensure accurate and relevant responses. The certification also emphasizes the importance of integrating AI agents with external systems and deploying them across various channels, ensuring seamless operation within enterprise environments. Additionally, the program addresses critical aspects of security and governance, including responsible AI practices, to ensure that AI solutions are not only innovative but also ethical and secure.
domain_summary: Agent Creation & Configuration: Skills for creating and configuring AI agents, including defining actions, triggers, and workflows.
Conversational Design: Designing effective conversation flows and managing topics for accurate agent responses.
Connectors/Integrations: Integrating AI agents with external systems and deploying them across channels.
Security & Governance: Ensuring AI agents adhere to security protocols and governance standards.
Responsible AI Governance: Adhering to fairness, transparency, accountability, and safety standards in AI agents.
blueprint.assessment_strategy: The assessment strategy for the AI Champion Certification is performance-based, focusing on the practical application of skills in real-world scenarios. Candidates are evaluated through a series of hands-on assessments that simulate enterprise environments, requiring them to demonstrate their ability to configure AI agents, design conversation flows, and integrate systems. This approach ensures that candidates not only understand theoretical concepts but can also apply them effectively in practice. The assessments are designed to test proficiency across various domains, with rubrics providing clear criteria for evaluating performance at different proficiency levels. This strategy ensures that certified professionals are well-equipped to handle the complexities of AI implementation in enterprise settings.
blueprint.renewal_cadence: The certification is recommended to be renewed every two years to ensure that professionals remain up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI technology and best practices. This interval allows for the incorporation of new skills and knowledge as the field evolves, maintaining the relevance and value of the certification.
